description: Store a durable local fact in amem (stays on this machine). After a dead end, record it as a failure (approach, symptom, cause, retry_when; no text needed) so no later session repeats it. Requires one of: text, or approach and symptom (a failure record). Use kind `private` (or anchor `private`) for personal, non-work facts so they never appear in work repositories' context. When the fact replaces an older one (a newer status, a fixed bug, a changed decision), pass the old claim ids in `supersedes` so the outdated memory stops being served. The response lists `possiblySupersedes`: older look-alikes to retire with amem_supersede if they are now wrong.

approach.description: Failure record: what was tried (with symptom, makes kind fail)

cause.description: Failure record: why it failed, if known

retry_when.description: Failure record: what must change before trying again

symptom.description: Failure record: what went wrong (error, wrong output)

name: amem_remember
